name: Marek Ironheart
summary: At the Farstrider Lodge in south-eastern Loch Modan, Marek Ironheart tests hunters who seek the lodge’s respect. The veteran dwarf follows the traditions of the wild.

sections.title: Master of the Hunt
sections.body: The Farstrider Lodge gathers marksmen and trackers from across the dwarven lands on a ridge above the lake. Marek cares little for titles or boasts. Visitors earn the hunters’ respect through skill against Loch Modan’s beasts, and by showing a true hunter’s patience and nerve.

faq.answer: At the Farstrider Lodge in Loch Modan, Marek Ironheart tests visitors seeking acceptance among its trackers and outdoorsmen.

faq.q: Where can I find Marek Ironheart?
faq.answer: Marek Ironheart can be found at the Farstrider Lodge, in the hills along Loch Modan’s south-eastern shore.

faq.q: What kind of tasks does Marek offer?
faq.answer: Marek sends hunters to track and cull local wildlife around the loch. Dangerous crocolisks test their skill at survival.

faq.q: Is Marek related to any other known dwarves?
faq.answer: Marek Ironheart may be kin to Archaeologist Adamant Ironheart and Imme Ironheart, who share his notable dwarven surname. Marek devotes his life to hunting rather than excavating relics.

angles.text: As a hunter, you see Marek Ironheart’s Farstrider Lodge traditions in challenges that test your accuracy and tracking against local wildlife.
As a dwarf, you see in Marek the outdoorsman culture cherished by many Khaz Modan dwarves. He chooses the mountains’ quiet watch over Ironforge’s forge fires.
